_comment: #318 beat 1. Rides the SHIPPED stationer_clerk, so his bark serves first and the graph opens on the second interact (Hedault's idiom). THE QUEST GATE LIVES ON THE OPTIONS, not the entity: the engine has no `conversation_when`, so an attached `conversation` is unconditional. All three real-cost arms therefore require house_card_shown as well as their own cost, and accomplishment gates HIDE, so pre-quest he shows only his refusal and his exit (spec section 4, fix round 1). The free ask is a signposting line: it banks nothing and loops back. Each banking arm hides on forged_hand_named.

counter.speaker: A Scribe by the Hour
counter.text: The blank seal is eight gold the hour. It goes back in the tray when the hour is up. That is the arrangement, {addr}. Nobody has ever asked me a second question about it.

text_variants.text: You have what you came for and I said nothing. That is the version I intend to remember. Paper is over there. Ink is behind me.

options.text: "Who has been hiring the blank seal?"
[Charming Smile] Ask about the handwriting instead of the name.

options._comment: The spend rides the GATE option, not the node behind it, so _is_priced_purchase fires and the row renders its price token.
options.text: "I'll buy the hour you were not working."
[Appraise Foe] The blotter under his elbow.

refuses.speaker: A Scribe by the Hour
refuses.text: No. Coin doesn't change it. Neither does the manners, and I'll thank you for them anyway. Nobody who rents this seal finds out who else rented it. That's what they're paying for. The day it stops being true, I am a man with very good handwriting and no work at all.

persuade_pitch.speaker: A Scribe by the Hour
persuade_pitch.text: Handwriting. Well. Handwriting is not a name, so I suppose I can be charmed about handwriting. Go on and be charming. It is usually about paper.

options.text: "It's about somebody wearing a house's initials by the hour."

persuade_close.speaker: A Scribe by the Hour
persuade_close.text: Then there is no confidence to keep. A confidence is a thing a client tells me, and this man was a renter who never said what he was renting. He works a table at the west end of the alleys, past the tea. He pays in coin and he pays late. That is everything I know about what he is.

paid.speaker: A Scribe by the Hour
paid.text: That buys the hour. You will notice it has not bought you an answer. I never saw who I wrote for. The seal came back to the tray with alley grit still in the cut, and there is exactly one man west of the tea who works out of an alley and can afford this shop.

blotter.speaker: A Scribe by the Hour
blotter.text: That is my— you are looking at my blotter. People do not look at my blotter.

options.text: "Your blotter keeps everything backwards. Including a set of initials that isn't yours to press."

blotter_read.speaker: A Scribe by the Hour
blotter_read.text: It is a blotter. It blots. If a man reads it and walks west past the tea and finds a table there, I never said a word to him. Remember it that way.
